messages.subject: TOPICS
parts:
Let’s start talking about Topics. Please reply with one of three types of posts:

  1. Topics that you would like to see. If we have plenty of “simpler” topics, perhaps we can have a “catch-all” meeting where several things are presented/discussed.
  2. Perhaps a Reply to a topic request if you can take it on or contribute as a team approach. If a topic starts to garner more conversation, we may spin it off into its own discussion.
  3. Topics that you volunteer to present. This might be as little as a micro-topic (see above), a full-fledged meeting topic, or perhaps a multi-part series (yippee!).

Periodically, we’ll either flush this discussion or start a new one.

​
